description: Project a periodic staggered velocity grid through a bounded weighted-Jacobi pressure solve.
output_invariants: Fresh finite row-major fields of length columns*rows; every field detached.

behavior.validation: Exact passive Object/null-prototype records and dense ordinary arrays; reject classes, accessors, symbols, extra keys, holes and coercion. All numbers finite binary64, integer fields safe. Validate every field and correspondence in schema order, then work preflight before arithmetic/output allocation. columns*rows must be safe <=4294967295 and each field array must have that length. No mutation, retained aliases or partial output; canonicalize output zero. Host allocation failure remains a host error.
behavior.environment: No RNG, clock, renderer, assets or host state. Row-major periodic rectangular domain, cell spacing1, x right and y down. Scalar centers(x,y), u right face(x+.5,y), v lower face(x,y+.5). Velocity in cell units per caller time. Other targets deferred; no original artist recreation claim.
behavior.numerics: IEEE754 binary64 separate ordered primitives, every arithmetic intermediate checked finite (NUMERIC_OVERFLOW), no FMA/reassociation or epsilon. Exact analytical JSON fixtures; additional analytical comparisons abs1e-9+rel1e-12, topology/indices/errors exact. Modulo indices wrap positively. No convergence or mass conservation inferred from an image.
behavior.work: N*(iterations+3) cell events safely precharged; O(N*(iterations+1)) time,O(N) storage.
behavior.algorithm: D_i=(u_i-u_left)+(v_i-v_up). Initialize pressure to zero. For each iteration synchronously, row-major: sum=((p_left+p_right)+p_up)+p_down; target=(sum-D_i)/4; next=p_i+(2/3)*(target-p_i). After iterations u_i=old_u_i-(p_right-p_i), v_i=old_v_i-(p_down-p_i). Recompute divergence with same order. Pressure is velocity correction potential, not physical pressure. Return all detached arrays. Zero iterations preserves velocity; finite iteration count does not promise zero divergence.
behavior.native_surface: projectPeriodicVelocity2D(input), error with stable code; package named export, p5 study.
